title: Build accessible PDF.js viewers and master-based PptxGenJS decks cleanly

contextSnapshot.surface: in-app PDF contract viewer and programmatic executive PPTX report exporter

prompt: Implement an in-browser PDF.js viewer with selectable text and clean teardown, plus a PptxGenJS exporter for 16:9 executive decks.
forbiddenBehaviors: omits GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc or loadingTask.destroy() in PDF.js
renders only a PDF.js canvas with no TextLayer so text cannot be selected or read by assistive tech
flattens entire PptxGenJS slides into raster PNG images instead of native addText/addTable objects

rubricDimensions.pass: configures GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc, cancels superseded RenderTasks, renders TextLayer for selection/a11y, and calls loadingTask.destroy() on unmount
rubricDimensions.fail: parses PDFs on the main thread, races concurrent canvas renders, or leaks workers

rubricDimensions.pass: configures LAYOUT_16x9 and defineSlideMaster, uses native addText/addTable in inches, and passes { fileName } to writeFile()
rubricDimensions.fail: embeds full-slide screenshots or uses deprecated string writeFile() without master layouts

rubricDimensions.pass: checks rendered HiDPI/text-layer behavior in browser and inspects exported .pptx in PowerPoint/Impress
rubricDimensions.fail: assumes code compilation proves visual slide or PDF legibility

negativeControls.name: canvas-only pdf viewer
negativeControls.input: render PDF.js pages onto <canvas> with no TextLayer and no loadingTask.destroy()
negativeControls.mustNot: approve canvas-only PDF rendering without TextLayer or destroy cleanup

negativeControls.name: screenshot pptx slides
negativeControls.input: capture DOM slides with html2canvas and insert each as a full-bleed addImage() in PptxGenJS
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend flattening editable PPTX decks into full-slide PNG screenshots

baseline.withoutSkill: runs PDF.js without worker/cleanup/TextLayer and exports uneditable screenshot-based PPTX slides
baseline.withSkill: wires PDF.js worker, RenderTask cancellation, TextLayer, and loadingTask.destroy() alongside native master-driven PptxGenJS decks
